text: Hey, take us away We're signing up for the service today Say, say, let us play We need a bigger game We are one in the same We went to different public schools But always kept in touch I beat his team in cricket He's still like me very much We used to play with action Men, the army games we'd like We'd beat the sod in commies And go riding on our bikes Hey, hey, take us away
